append.detail: PROBE AMENDED 2026-10-12 (ADR-1733, LIVE-901). Clause 7.4 grepped createSpace's redirect line for /manage/circles. A new Business or Nonprofit Space now opens /spaces/<slug>/setup first (lib/spaces/setup.ts postCreateLanding) and that walk finishes on /manage/circles, so 7.4 now checks that createSpace redirects through postCreateLanding and that the setup rule still finishes on hosting. The consequence this row measures, a first run that lands on the four nouns and not the CRM, is unchanged.
